description: DN-QKBD12-A is the drawing identifier for disconnect terminal block in AutomationDirect's DINnectors and DIN Rail collection. A disconnect terminal block provides a selected separable connection within a wiring strip. Its disconnecting part, conductor terminals and any accessories need to be coordinated as the documented terminal assembly.

For example, in a control-panel marshalling strip with an accessible circuit-disconnection point, use the DN-QKBD12-A reference to coordinate disconnect operation, conductor approach and terminal identification. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Other PLC Products/DINnectors/Disconnect Terminal Blocks/DN-QKBD12-A.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep disconnect operation, conductor approach and terminal identification visible in the layout.
